name: Decky Downloader
author: 60plus
summary: Download files, torrents, videos and music right inside Steam. Manage your queue with a gamepad or touch, and send links from your PC or phone.
description:
## Your downloads, right inside Steam
Download files, torrents, videos and music on your Steam Deck or gaming PC, then get back to your game. Designed for SPlug and Decky Loader, with a window on PC and a full-screen interface on handhelds.

## A queue you control
Pause and resume transfers, retry interrupted downloads, choose what downloads next and clear completed entries. Your files stay on disk. Pick internal storage, a mounted SD card or USB drive, and create folders with your gamepad or touch.

## Send from your PC or phone
Send links over your home network through the built-in web page or Firefox companion. Choose a destination on the handheld and follow progress live, using your own password. Upload a .torrent file from your PC and choose its contents directly in the web page or Firefox companion. No cloud account is needed.

## Make it yours
Set simultaneous downloads and speed limits, configure BitTorrent connections and choose English or Polish. Downloads keep running when you close the plugin window, while the device stays awake.

First launch sets up Varia's download engines automatically. Initial setup needs Flatpak, internet access and storage. This independent plugin is inspired by Varia and made by 60plus.

## Choose torrent files and share back
Pick individual files with your gamepad or touch before a torrent starts downloading. Enable optional seeding in BitTorrent settings and choose a ratio limit; the upload total survives pause and restart. Downloads take priority over seeders.
instructions:
## Getting started
1. Install the plugin through SPlug or Decky Loader and open Decky Downloader.
2. Allow first-start setup to install the official Varia Flatpak. Check Settings for setup status; use Install / update Varia to retry or update it.
3. Select Add download, choose a transfer type, enter its URL or local torrent path, and select a destination.
4. Use the download list and details to pause, resume, retry or cancel transfers.

## Controls
- D-pad / left stick: navigate.
- A: activate or open details.
- B: go back or close the modal from the list.
- X: add a download from the list.
- Y: open Settings from the list.
- LB / RB: change the list filter.
- Touch / mouse: use the visible buttons.

Settings provides Auto, Window and Full screen layout options. Uninstalling the plugin leaves Varia and downloaded files in place.

## 0.1.12
- Manage the full download queue from the local web page: pause, resume/retry, cancel, remove, move to front and bulk actions.
- General, BitTorrent, Browser and engine settings are now available remotely, including yt-dlp updates.
- Browse and import torrent files already stored on the handheld.
- Firefox Sender 0.1.5 adds queue controls and a link to the full manager.

## 0.1.11
- Add optional automatic yt-dlp updates in Download engines settings.
- Check daily while the plugin is running and install newer official releases.
- Preserve the schedule across restarts; retry failed checks after one hour.
- Skip downloading an engine that is already current and keep manual updates available.

## 0.1.10
- Update yt-dlp independently of the older version bundled with Varia.
- Show the active video-engine version in Download engines settings.
- Verify official release checksums and keep the previous engine if an update fails.
- Explain HTTP 403 video failures and point to the update action.

## 0.1.9
- Upload .torrent files from your PC through the web page or Firefox Sender 0.1.4.
- Choose torrent contents remotely, including for torrent links and magnets.
- Pause active torrents remotely to change selected files.
- Keep selections and focus while live progress updates; browse large torrents in pages.
- Open the Firefox companion in a full tab for more space.

## 0.1.8
- Select individual files from local torrents, HTTP torrent links and magnets before downloading.
- Preserve file choices and cached metadata through pause and restart.
- Add optional seeding with a persistent upload counter and configurable ratio limit.
- Give queued downloads priority over seeding, including when one torrent port is configured.
- Add gamepad/touch file selection, selection and seeding filters, and upload statistics.

- Find paused, failed and cancelled transfers in Interrupted and resume them together.
- Keep resume, cancel and remove actions visible below download details.
